subject: data1.dat — exhaustive 2^32 stream-key sweep (dword cipher) + ciphertext-only cryptanalysis
tool: evidence/m2b_x_sweep.c (PCLMULQDQ-accelerated, OpenMP, self-tested against the Python reference)

sweep_scope.key_space: all 2^32 values of the stream key x
sweep_scope.method: the first 4 decrypted dwords depend only on x (stream state seeded by x alone), so prefix oracles cover the full space at ~100 Mkeys/s

oracles.A_scatter: plaintext starts with {u32 base, u32 n, u32 entries_off, u32 data_off} with entries_off == 16, 1 <= n <= 0x1000, data_off within file (calibrated on real M1b chunks: base=0x1fd0 n=1 eoff=0x10 doff=0x20)
oracles.B_dd70: stream-decrypted buffer parses as a dd70 header: count in [1,255], kts in [3,0x1B00] and kts%3==0, total in [1,0x8000000] with seed = ((x^2)>>17)^((x^2)<<11)

results.A_scatter: 0 hits over the ENTIRE 2^32 key space, BOTH views
results.B_dd70_full_tiling: 41/41 sampled candidates FAIL the exact-cover tiling check (pairs decode + no gaps/overlaps + exact end); raw hit rate 156/8.6e9 = 2^-25.7 matches the computed chance rate 2^-24.5 — all false positives
results.conclusion: data1.dat is NOT encrypted with the e3/stage-2 dword stream cipher under ANY key — neither as a raw scatter chunk (the FUN_00002b10 pipeline output) nor as a stream-wrapped dd70 container

ciphertext_only_cryptanalysis.byte_chi2_over_256: 16.03 (uniform would be ~1.0; the protector e2 blob measures 1.106, the game 0xf3 blob 1.145, real dd70 chunks 0.85-1.26)
ciphertext_only_cryptanalysis.position_structure: EVEN bytes (low byte of every u16) carry all the bias; ODD bytes (high byte) are uniform (chi2 27.2 vs 1.4)
ciphertext_only_cryptanalysis.bit_leak_signature: bits 0-1 of EVERY u16 are biased (P(b0=1)=0.441, P(b1=1)=0.476; P(00)=32.6% vs 25%); all other u16 bits ~0.500 — i.e. dword bits 0,1,16,17
ciphertext_only_cryptanalysis.stream_cipher_bit0_theorem: in the (-x)^x construction bit0(c) == bit0(p) exactly (the i-dependent constant terms also cancel: bit0(A_i) ^ bit0(B_i) == (i&1)^(i&1) == 0) — verified empirically: bit-0 fraction is invariant under stream_decrypt with every key
ciphertext_only_cryptanalysis.dword_cipher_cannot_explain_bit16: encrypting real plaintexts (ARM64 code, scatter/LZ chunks) through the dword stream cipher reproduces their bit-0 bias at dword bit 0 but NEVER at bit 16 (measured 0.503-0.506); data1.dat shows bit 16 = 0.442 — therefore the cipher granularity is 16 BIT, not 32
structural_tests_negative: repeating-key XOR (byte autocorrelation lags 1..16384): no period
u16 port of the stream cipher (truncated constants, 2 init variants, all 65536 keys): no oracle hits
shift-XOR obfuscations c = p ^ (p<<k) / c = p ^ (p>>k), u16 and u32, k=1..31 inverted: no structure
delta/xor chains (c[k]-c[k-1], c[k]^c[k-1]): no alignment gain
stage-1 family (v += (i+3)*key; v ^= (i+1)*0xBF20165D) with 13 key candidates x u32/u16 forms: no structure
ciphertext_only_cryptanalysis.interpretation: data1.dat's body is protected by a WEAKER, 16-bit-granular cipher (keystream never touches bits 0-1 of each u16, or a transform that preserves them) implemented in the game's hidden code (device 0x8f / the 38.5MB 0xf3 blob) — stronger than obfuscation (entropy 7.99) but categorically different from every protector-side cipher

cross_file_statistics.protector_e2_968836B: [4B][16-aligned] shape like data1.dat but chi2 = 1.106 (uniform) — DIFFERENT scheme
cross_file_statistics.data1_dat_181700B: chi2 = 16.03 with the u16 bit leak — unique among the encrypted assets

next_leads: the consumer + cipher live in the still-encrypted game blob; its own scheme (uniform output) remains unknown
bit-0/1 of every u16 in data1.dat are PLAINTEXT bits readable without any key — 90848 observable bits usable for known-plaintext attacks once the plaintext family is guessed
the 4-byte head 0x3ecbf1da is not a crc32 of body/full, not a length, not stream-index-0 material
